name: hexdelve
description: Hexagon game-world engine, client and editor

scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build:client && npm run build:editor
scripts.build:libs: tsc -b packages/shared packages/engine packages/client packages/desktop packages/editor-desktop
scripts.build:editor-desktop: npm run build:editor && npm run build -w @hexdelve/editor-desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/engine packages/client packages/editor packages/desktop packages/editor-desktop && tsc -p packages/client/scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
